one_line_description.value: GitHub is a platform for hosting code in public or private Git repositories, accessible via web and command line, with collaboration features such as pull requests, Actions, and code review.
one_line_description.quote: Host open source projects in public GitHub repositories, accessible via web or command line.

has_public_api.quote: Comparing GitHub's REST API and GraphQL API Learn about GitHub's APIs to extend and customize your GitHub experience.

api_type.quote: Use the REST API to interact with references in your Git database on GitHub

api_breadth.value: Broad read-write REST API covering repositories, Git refs, issues, pull requests, Actions, and org/permission administration; fully specified in an OpenAPI document.
api_breadth.quote: The GitHub REST API is fully described in an OpenAPI compliant document.

docs_url.quote: Quickstart for GitHub REST API Learn how to get started with the GitHub REST API.

auth_methods.quote: In most cases, you can use `Authorization: Bearer` or `Authorization: token` to pass a token. However, if you are passing a JSON web token (JWT), you must use `Authorization: Bearer`.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Also, notice that the URL uses the `scope` query parameter to define the scopes requested by the application.

access_model.quote: If you want to use the GitHub REST API for personal use, you can create a personal access token.

access_notes.value: A free GitHub account with a self-created personal access token (or OAuth app / GitHub App registration) is sufficient; no sales contact or paid plan is required. Access to organization resources can be gated by SAML SSO token authorization and org policies, and Enterprise Cloud-owned apps get higher rate limits.
access_notes.quote: If you use a personal access token (classic) to access an organization that enforces SAML single sign-on (SSO) for authentication, you will need to authorize your token after creation.

official_mcp_server.quote: The remote GitHub MCP Server is hosted by GitHub and provides the easiest method for getting up and running.

rate_limits.value: 60 requests/hour unauthenticated; higher personal limits when authenticated (5,000 requests/hour minimum for GitHub App installations, 15,000 requests/hour for GitHub Enterprise Cloud-owned apps/installations); Git LFS 300 requests/min unauthenticated and 3,000 requests/min authenticated.
rate_limits.quote: The primary rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour.

sdk_languages.quote: Scripting with the REST API and JavaScript Write a script using the Octokit.js SDK to interact with the REST API. - Scripting with the REST API and Ruby Learn how to write a script using the Octokit.rb SDK to interact with the REST API.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Date-based REST API versions are selected with the X-GitHub-Api-Version header (current example: 2026-03-10); the docs include dedicated 'API Versions' and 'Breaking changes' pages describing each version's changes.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: Most endpoints use `Authorization: Bearer ` and `Accept: application/vnd.github+json` headers, plus `X-GitHub-Api-Version: 2026-03-10`.

verdict_reason: GitHub documents a fully OpenAPI-specified public REST API with broad read-write coverage across repos, refs, issues, PRs, and Actions. Credentials are self-serve: a developer can create a personal access token or OAuth/GitHub App on a free account with no sales contact. Generous documented rate limits and official Octokit SDKs make a toolkit straightforward to build.
open_questions: Webhooks: the search plan surfaced webhook documentation URLs, but no fetched SOURCES page contains webhook text, so the webhooks field is null/not_found rather than asserted.
Sandbox/test environment: no fetched source documents a GitHub API sandbox or test environment (only a community discussion snippet), so this is not_found.
SDK languages: only JavaScript (Octokit.js) and Ruby (Octokit.rb) are named in the fetched docs; other Octokit ports may exist but were not evidenced here.
Community MCP servers: no non-vendor MCP server URLs appeared in the fetched SOURCES; github/github-mcp-server is vendor-owned and therefore recorded as the official server.
GraphQL API: mentioned as existing (docs comparison page and rate-limit page) but not researched in depth because the input hint targets docs.github.com/rest.
